tolerance_rationale: ADR 0005 (2026-11-13, second revision) + ticket 04d: this is the 16-bit ACTIVATION tier (4W16A). Operator criterion: device == quantised golden, |delta| <= int8_tol codes, AND |cos(device) - cos(golden)| <= 0.003 (device fidelity); quality is judged by cosine vs the independent fp64 chain. int8_tol=1 is registered before the first board run for components; the layer registers 2 for the int8 RMSNorm/int8 seam chain (see LAYER_TOL) or 1 when the graph is fully int16 (registered before the run, no adjustment afterwards).

precision_tier.requant: tools/quant_contract.py: two integer roundings, per-channel multipliers

quality_criterion.code_criterion: device vs quantised golden: |delta| <= int8_tol codes

accuracy_vs_fp32.note: int8 quantisation error of the whole 4W8A path, no device involved
